provenance.text: All 54 boards Shredpace ships, in Ember dark — the site's own default theme, with its real tokens, radii and typefaces. The landing page and sign-in are drawn from what was rendered. On 18 Nov a signed-in Studio account was read. Contact, Legal and the avatar menu were corrected from it, and 29 boards were redrawn from the live screens in Studio light, most of them again after the account held real data: they carry 'redrawn from the live screen' in their titles, so they sit beside Ember-dark boards that were not. Every other signed-in board is still reconstructed from the shipped router, board registry and OpenAPI schemas, and the redrawn ones hold sample figures. Figures are plausible examples, not anyone's data. Boards click through: the sidebar and the phone tab bar navigate. Five states were added on 18 Nov from the publisher's changelog: MissedDays, a comeback question, StudioNew, ConnectKeyPhone and NavigationMore.
